---
pagetitle: "Pluszone Education | Shop"
description: "『인성 교육, 참! 잘하는 교사』 한국어판(교보문고·예스24·알라딘)과 영문판 A Teacher's Guide to the Art of Character Education(아마존) 구매처 안내."
image: og-image.jpg
open-graph:
  title: "도서 구매 | 인성 교육, 참! 잘하는 교사"
  locale: ko_KR
twitter-card:
  title: "도서 구매 | 인성 교육, 참! 잘하는 교사"
lang: ko
format:
  html:
    page-layout: custom
    toc: false
    anchor-sections: false
    smooth-scroll: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@400;600;700;900&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
        <style>
        :root{
          --paper:#FDF6EE; --paper-2:#FBE7D3; --sand:#F8D9BA; --line:#EFDCC8;
          --ink:#2B221D; --text:#3A302A; --muted:#6A5C52;
          --accent:#A84A0D; --accent-dark:#7F370A; --accent-soft:#F39A2B; --label:#8A4A12;
          --serif:'Noto Serif KR', Georgia, serif;
          --sans:'Noto Sans KR','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;
        }
        html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
        body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:17px;line-height:1.8}
        a{color:var(--accent)} a:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}
        h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--ink);margin:0;border:0}
        p{margin:0}
        .wrap{max-width:1248px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px}
        .eyebrow{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--label);letter-spacing:3px}

        /* 상단 메뉴 (Quarto navbar) */
        .navbar{background:var(--paper)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:none}
        .navbar .navbar-brand,.navbar .navbar-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:900;font-size:24px;color:var(--ink)!important}
        .navbar .nav-link{color:var(--ink)!important;font-weight:500}
        .navbar .nav-link:hover,.navbar .nav-link.active{color:var(--accent)!important}
        .navbar-toggler{border-color:var(--line)}
        .navbar-toggler-icon{background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 30 30'%3e%3cpath stroke='%232B221D' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-width='2' d='M4 7h22M4 15h22M4 23h22'/%3e%3c/svg%3e")!important}

        /* 히어로 */
        .hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;padding-top:40px;padding-bottom:96px;align-items:center}
        .hero-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px}
        .hero h1{font-size:68px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-2px}
        .hero .tagline{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--accent)}
        .hero .summary{color:#4A3F38;max-width:560px}
        .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
        .buy{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding-top:8px}
        .buy-btn{min-height:56px;padding:0 30px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
        .buy-btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
        .buy-btn.primary:hover{background:var(--accent-dark);color:#fff}
        .buy-btn:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}
        .cover-stage{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:16px 0 40px}
        .cover-stage::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:56px 20px 0 60px;background:var(--sand);border-radius:4px}
        .cover{position:relative;width:380px;max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:380/540;background:#FBE3CC;color:var(--paper);border-radius:3px 8px 8px 3px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(90,45,10,.28);box-sizing:border-box;padding:56px 44px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
        .cover img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit;margin:0}
        .cover p,.cover figure{margin:0}
        .cover .t{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:44px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.3}
        .cover .note{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;opacity:.85}
        .cover .foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:15px}

        /* 인용 띠 */
        .quote-band{border-top:6px solid var(--accent-soft);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);text-align:center;padding:72px 32px}
        .quote-band p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:600;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto}
        .quote-band small{display:block;margin-top:16px;color:#D9C9B8;font-size:15px}

        /* 공통 섹션 */
        .section{padding:112px 0 0}
        .section h2{font-size:40px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35}
        .intro .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr;gap:64px}
        .intro .illus{margin-top:32px}
        .intro .illus p{margin:0}
        .intro .illus img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
        .intro .body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text)}
        .sec-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);padding-bottom:20px;margin-bottom:40px}

        /* 목차 */
        .toc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px 80px}
        .toc-item{display:flex;gap:24px}
        .toc-item .n{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:36px;font-weight:900;color:var(--accent);width:56px;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1.2}
        .toc-item b{display:block;font-size:20px}
        .toc-item span{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted)}

        /* 책 속으로 */
        .inside{background:var(--paper-2);border-radius:12px;padding:64px 80px}
        .inside .cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;margin-top:28px}
        .inside blockquote{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:21px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--ink)}
        .inside blockquote footer{margin-top:16px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

        /* 추천 독자 */
        .readers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;margin-top:40px}
        .reader{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:32px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
        .reader b{font-size:20px}
        .reader span{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}

        /* 저자 */
        .author .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
        .author .head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
        .author .info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
        .author .info p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text)}

        /* 출간 도서 */
        .books-wrap{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:112px;padding-top:80px}
        .books{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px}
        .book{display:flex;gap:28px;padding:28px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
        .book.current{border:2px solid var(--accent)}
        .book:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
        .book .mini{width:120px;height:171px;border-radius:2px 5px 5px 2px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--accent);object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(90,45,10,.18)}
        .book .mini.dark{background:var(--ink)}
        .book .txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
        .book .kind{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--label);letter-spacing:2px}
        .book .ttl{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4}
        .book .by{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}

        /* 푸터 */
        .site-footer{border-top:6px solid var(--accent-soft);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);margin-top:112px;padding:72px 0}
        .site-footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap}
        .site-footer .brand{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;font-weight:900}
        .site-footer .sub{font-size:15px;color:#D9C9B8}
        .site-footer .contact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
        .site-footer .contact a{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:var(--paper)}
        .site-footer .copy{font-size:13px;color:#B5A594;padding-top:24px}

        .meta p,.buy p{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:inherit;margin:0}
        .cover p{margin:0}
        .cover .note,.cover .t{display:block}
        .foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
        .toc-item p{display:flex;gap:24px;margin:0}
        .readers .reader p{margin:0}
        .readers .reader strong{font-size:20px}
        .readers .reader span{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
        .inside blockquote p{margin:0}
        .quote-band p{margin-bottom:0}
        .author{padding-bottom:0}
        .contact-line{margin-top:48px;padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:96px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted)}
        .contact-line p{margin:0}
        .contact-line a{font-weight:700;margin-left:12px}
        a:focus-visible,.buy-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--label);outline-offset:3px}

        /* 모바일 */
        @media (max-width: 900px){
          body{font-size:16px}
          .wrap{padding:0 20px}
          .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px;padding-top:24px;padding-bottom:56px}
          .hero .cover-stage{order:-1;padding:0}
          .cover-stage::before{display:none}
          .cover{width:220px;padding:32px 24px}
          .cover .t{font-size:28px}
          .hero h1{font-size:38px;letter-spacing:-1px}
          .hero .tagline{font-size:18px}
          .buy-btn{flex:1 1 40%;min-height:50px}
          .buy-btn.primary{flex-basis:100%}
          .quote-band{padding:48px 24px}
          .quote-band p{font-size:21px}
          .section{padding-top:56px}
          .section h2{font-size:28px}
          .intro .wrap,.author .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
          .intro .illus{margin:16px 0 8px}
          .intro .body,.author .info p{font-size:16px}
          .toc-grid,.inside .cols,.books{grid-template-columns:1fr}
          .toc-item .n{font-size:24px;width:36px}
          .inside{padding:32px 24px}
          .inside blockquote{font-size:17px}
          .readers{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
          .reader{padding:20px 18px}
          .contact-line{margin-top:32px;padding-bottom:56px}
          .book .mini{width:80px;height:114px}
          .book .ttl{font-size:19px}
          .books-wrap{margin-top:56px;padding-top:48px}
          .site-footer{margin-top:56px;padding:48px 0}
          .site-footer .contact{align-items:flex-start}
          .site-footer .contact a{font-size:18px}
        }
        /* Shop page */
        .shop-head{padding:48px 0 8px}
        .shop-head h1{font-size:48px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-1px}
        .shop-head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}
        .editions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;margin-top:40px}
        .edition{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:36px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:start}
        .edition img{width:160px;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:2px 6px 6px 2px;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(90,45,10,.2)}
        .edition .info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
        .edition .ttl{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink)}
        .edition .sub{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
        .edition .stores{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
        .edition .stores .buy-btn{min-height:50px;padding:0 24px}
        @media (max-width: 900px){
          .shop-head{padding-top:24px}
          .shop-head h1{font-size:32px}
          .editions{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:24px}
          .edition{grid-template-columns:96px 1fr;gap:20px;padding:24px 20px}
          .edition img{width:96px}
          .edition .ttl{font-size:19px}
          .edition .stores .buy-btn{flex:1 1 100%}
        }
        </style>
---

<!-- 도서 구매 페이지. 구매 링크는 모두 이 페이지에서 관리합니다. -->
